tool_schemas.name: executeJavaScript
tool_schemas.description: Executes the provided JavaScript source code inside the specified SMART-E2B sandbox and returns a run result containing the program’s output (stdout/stderr), exit status, and any execution metadata produced by the run. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if sandbox_id does not match the required format, code is missing/empty, or timeout_seconds is provided but is < 1. Raises NOT_FOUND if the sandbox_id does not exist (or is no longer available), FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to execute in that sandbox, and TIMEOUT if the run exceeds timeout_seconds and is terminated.

sandbox_id.description: ID of the sandbox to run the code in.

stdin.description: Optional standard input passed to the program.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum execution time before the run is terminated.

tool_schemas.name: executePython
tool_schemas.description: Executes the provided Python source code inside the specified SMART-E2B sandbox and returns a run result containing the program’s output (stdout/stderr), exit status, and any execution metadata produced by the run. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if sandbox_id does not match the required format, code is missing/empty, or timeout_seconds is provided but is < 1. Raises NOT_FOUND if the sandbox_id does not exist (or is no longer available), FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to execute in that sandbox, and TIMEOUT if the run exceeds timeout_seconds and is terminated.

sandbox_id.description: ID of the sandbox to run the code in.

stdin.description: Optional standard input passed to the program.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum execution time before the run is terminated.

tool_schemas.name: uploadFile
tool_schemas.description: Uploads a file into the specified sandbox virtual filesystem at the given full path, creating or overwriting the file, and returns metadata for the stored file (including its path and size). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if sandbox_id is invalid, path or content_base64 is missing, or content_base64 is not valid base64, and raises NOT_FOUND if the sandbox_id does not exist (or is no longer available). Raises FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to write to that sandbox and CONFLICT if the path cannot be created because it conflicts with an existing non-file entry at that location.

sandbox_id.description: ID of the sandbox to upload the file into.

path.description: Full sandbox file path to create/overwrite (e.g., /mnt/data/input.txt).

content_type.description: MIME content type of the uploaded file (e.g., text/plain, application/json).

tool_schemas.name: listFiles
tool_schemas.description: Lists file records under the given sandbox directory and returns a paged result set ordered by the requested sort and order; use limit to control page size and pass the returned cursor to fetch the next page until no further cursor is provided. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if sandbox_id is invalid, directory is missing, limit is outside 1–200, or any enum parameter (status/sort/order) is not one of the allowed values. Raises NOT_FOUND if the sandbox_id does not exist (or is no longer available) and FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to view files in that sandbox.

sandbox_id.description: ID of the sandbox whose files are being listed.

directory.description: Directory path in the sandbox to list (e.g., /mnt/data).

limit.description: Maximum number of file records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: readFile
tool_schemas.description: Reads the contents of a file at the given path from the sandbox virtual filesystem and returns the file data encoded as requested (base64 or utf-8) along with basic file metadata. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if sandbox_id is invalid, path is missing, or encoding is not one of the allowed values. Raises NOT_FOUND if the sandbox_id does not exist (or is no longer available) or the file at path does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to read from that sandbox.

sandbox_id.description: ID of the sandbox containing the file.

path.description: Full sandbox file path to read.

encoding.description: Preferred response encoding for the file contents.

tool_schemas.name: getCaller
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated caller identity for the presented SMART-E2B API key, including the api_key_id, current key status, effective scopes/permissions, and the caller’s current quota and rate-limit snapshot. Refuses UNAUTHORIZED if the key is missing/invalid, and FORBIDDEN if the key is not in status='active'.

api_key.description: SMART-E2B API key presented for authentication (sent exactly as issued).

tool_schemas.name: createSandbox
tool_schemas.description: Creates (or reuses, if available) an ephemeral SMART-E2B sandbox for the authenticated API key and returns the sandbox metadata. If reuse_if_ready is true, the service returns an existing sandbox in status='ready' for the caller when possible; otherwise it provisions a new sandbox (provisioning -> ready). Refuses UNAUTHORIZED/ FORBIDDEN for invalid/inactive keys and may refuse with RATE_LIMITED when the caller is rate-limited.

api_key.description: SMART-E2B API key presented for authentication (sent exactly as issued).

region.description: Preferred region for the sandbox. If omitted, a default region is selected.

runtime_image.description: Optional runtime image identifier for the sandbox (vendor-defined).

idle_ttl_seconds.description: Idle time-to-live in seconds. When exceeded, the sandbox expires and becomes unavailable.

reuse_if_ready.description: When true (default), returns an existing ready sandbox for this API key if one exists; otherwise creates a new sandbox.

tool_schemas.name: getSandbox
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single sandbox by id and returns its current status and metadata. Refuses NOT_FOUND if the sandbox does not exist or is not accessible to the authenticated API key. Refuses FORBIDDEN if the API key is inactive.

api_key.description: SMART-E2B API key presented for authentication (sent exactly as issued).

sandbox_id.description: ID of the sandbox to fetch.

tool_schemas.name: stopSandbox
tool_schemas.description: Stops a sandbox, transitioning its lifecycle state to 'stopped' when allowed (e.g., from provisioning/ready/busy/error per lifecycle rules) and returns the updated sandbox metadata. Refuses NOT_FOUND if the sandbox does not exist or is not accessible to the caller. Refuses CONFLICT if the requested transition is not allowed from the current status.

api_key.description: SMART-E2B API key presented for authentication (sent exactly as issued).

sandbox_id.description: ID of the sandbox to stop.

reason.description: Optional human-readable reason for stopping the sandbox (stored for audit/usage tracking).

tool_schemas.name: resumeSandbox
tool_schemas.description: Resumes a previously stopped sandbox by transitioning it to 'ready' when allowed and returns the updated sandbox metadata. Refuses NOT_FOUND if the sandbox does not exist or is not accessible. Refuses CONFLICT if the sandbox is expired or the transition is not allowed from the current status.

api_key.description: SMART-E2B API key presented for authentication (sent exactly as issued).

sandbox_id.description: ID of the sandbox to resume.

tool_schemas.name: cancelExecution
tool_schemas.description: Cancels an in-flight execution by id, transitioning status from 'queued' or 'running' to 'cancelled' when allowed, and returns the updated execution record. Refuses NOT_FOUND if the execution does not exist or is not accessible to the authenticated API key. Refuses CONFLICT if the execution is already terminal (succeeded/failed/timeout/cancelled) or cannot be cancelled in its current state.

api_key.description: SMART-E2B API key presented for authentication (sent exactly as issued).

execution_id.description: ID of the execution to cancel.

metadata.name: SMART-E2B
metadata.description: SMART-E2B stores metadata for ephemeral secure sandboxes, code execution runs (Python/JavaScript), and a per-sandbox virtual filesystem (uploaded and generated files).
